figures.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: Figure 1 conceptual preview for a scientific manuscript titled "How autonomous research shapes scientific understanding".
Create one polished landscape scientific conceptual diagram, 3:2 aspect ratio, white background, generous spacing, precise flat line illustration with subtle material texture, restrained navy, teal and amber. Clear short English labels in a clean sans-serif font, readable at paper width. A modest title "Studying autonomous inquiry".
Composition: upper two-thirds shows an autonomous researcher as a small neutral computational module, connected bidirectionally to a programmable chemistry world containing a persistent reaction vessel, separation flask and crystalline sample. The researcher-to-world arrow is labelled "Choose experiments"; world-to-researcher arrow "Receive observations". An independent evaluator sits apart on the right with a shielded world-law card and comparison lens, labelled "Independent evaluation"; it controls world laws and checks outcomes. Do NOT draw an evaluator-to-researcher feedback arrow.
Lower third: a left-to-right sequence "Research question" → "Experimental choices" → "Observed evidence" → "Scientific judgments" → "New-condition predictions". A slender return arrow from Scientific judgments to Experimental choices denotes continuing inquiry before the final assessment. Tiny notebook sheets appear by the judgment node.
Small footer text exactly "Concept preview · not a quantitative figure".
No charts, axes, data points, numeric findings, empirical trajectories, journal branding, robot faces, or claims of direct access to hidden cognition. Visually distinguish the agent's public observations from evaluator-only world laws. This is a conceptual explanation, not an empirical results plot.

Allowable operations are public to the researcher, so they must not be listed as evaluator-only. Keep all other labels, shapes, colors, layout and arrows unchanged.
